resources.string: MCP clients on your network that have the token can ask ClosePaw to run tasks on this phone.
Let MCP clients (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) ask ClosePaw to run tasks on this phone. Tasks run in the background on the virtual display (Shizuku).
Endpoint: %1$s (Streamable HTTP). Send the header \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\".
Endpoint: http://<this phone\'s IP>:%1$d/mcp. Connect to Wi-Fi to see the address.
New token created. The old token no longer works.
Anyone on the same network who has this token can make ClosePaw operate your phone. Regenerate it if it leaks.
